# Jobicy fixture

`remote-jobs-brazil.json` is a real response from
`https://jobicy.com/api/v2/remote-jobs?count=100&geo=brazil`, fetched on 2026-10-18 with no
key. It was trimmed to 5 of its 61 jobs: one with a salary, two open "Anywhere", one for
Argentina, Brazil and Mexico, and one outside software. Emails in the descriptions became
`jobs@example.com` (none were found).
